headline: New rooftop solar rules take effect without including residences; environmental groups call for full implementation by 12/1 | Politics
summary: A rule requiring rooftop solar on large new buildings took effect on August 1 but excludes residential buildings, shops and clinics. Environmental groups demand full implementation by December 1.
why: Rooftop solar mandates shape demand for solar installers and the pace of Taiwan's energy transition.
